updates.description: Different SM fairing geometry with added winglets offering local load for high downforce tracks. Local trailing edge extensions added on the rear wing third element for efficient load increase.
Additional front wing load is generated by adding Gurney flaps to the trailing edge. This provides extended balance range for the car for setup optimisation during the weekend.

updates.description: Provides improved aerodynamic flow conditioning at the back of the car, to aid with efficient load generation from the floor.
An alternative Rear Impact Structure device will be available on track, enabling targeted tuning of the car’s characteristics for this circuit.
